# Natural Language Dataset Query

The Apify actor [`apify/natural-language-dataset-query`](https://apify.com/apify/natural-language-dataset-query) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **0.0.3** (module version **0.1.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

Use natural language queries to retrieve results from an Apify dataset. This Actor provides a query engine that loads a dataset, executes SQL queries, and synthesizes results. It works as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server or REST API in Actor standby mode.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/natural-language-dataset-query) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-natural-language-dataset-query@0.1.0#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Telo.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      query: "What is the total number of pages containing the keyword 'apple'?"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes | `"What is the total number of pages containing the keyword 'a` | Query — Query for the LLM. |
| `dataset` | string | yes |  | Dataset — ID of the dataset to query. |
| `modelName` | string |  | `"google/gemini-2.5-flash"` | OpenAI model — The OpenAI model to use. Currently supported models are Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4.1, and GPT-4.1 Mini. |
| `debug` | boolean |  | `false` | Debug — If enabled, Actor provides detailed information with tool calls and reasoning. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
